description: This script computes and aggregates interface information for IDL files, including inheritance, dependencies, and public interface data, and serializes the results as a pickle file.

classes.name: IdlInterfaceFileNotFoundError
classes.description: Exception raised when an IDL interface file cannot be found.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for the script.

methods.name: dict_of_dicts_of_lists_update_or_append
methods.description: Merges nested dictionaries of lists, appending values for existing keys.

methods.name: compute_inheritance_info
methods.description: Calculates ancestors and inherited extended attributes for a given interface.

methods.name: compute_global_type_info
methods.description: Aggregates global type information such as all interfaces, callbacks, dictionaries, and component directories.

methods.name: compute_interfaces_info_overall
methods.description: Main function to process individual interface info and compute inheritance, dependencies, and other aggregate data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to read input pickles, process data, and output the aggregated interface info.
